summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to send one GET /v2/settlements with only merchant_id, canonical tz (link names and UTC+HH:MM mapped to zone ids), from, half-open to (first day of the next month) and a BCP 47 locale. Amounts are now rounded as decimals per currency digits and written with locale-specific separators, as the dashboard does. The meridale-display page was unreadable through get_doc (403), so I reconstructed it from search snippets. The meridale-rounding page also conflicts with itself: get_doc says half up, while the search index and the changelog say half to even. I used half to even.
